description: The image a post needs, generated with the brand kit and the client's style references, and LOOKED AT against a checklist before it is shown
client_copy: Genera las imágenes de tus posteos con tu identidad y con el estilo de las referencias que le pasaste.
_comment: IT DEPENDS ON brand-kit BECAUSE THE BRIEF DOES: «Sin `brand.json` corta y te
da la pregunta para ofrecerle armar el kit». The exact hexes and the typeface
come out of the kit, and writing them from memory is how a feed stops looking
TOOLSETS, BOTH OF THEM NAMED IN THE SKILL. `image_gen` is step 2 -- «Generá
con `image_generate`», and the SKILL.md says the terminal script is not a way
out because the engine strips the provider key from the agent's shell, so the
engine's toolset is the only path. `vision` is step 4 -- «MIRÁ lo que salió.
Siempre. No muestres una imagen que no miraste» -- and that step is the one
that catches the misspelled text before it reaches the client's Instagram.
The toolset names are the engine's own (compose/config.base.yaml lists both
under platform_toolsets); `image_generate` is the tool, `image_gen` the
IT DOES NOT DEPEND ON deliverable. «Adjuntala al entregable del flujo» is the
flow's deliverable, made by whoever runs the flow; this skill copies the file
out of the engine's cache into the workspace and never runs deliver.py.
